description: This file defines a C# interface for Orleans grains, specifically for testing client addressable rendezvous grains, including methods to get and set a producer.

classes.name: IClientAddressableTestRendezvousGrain
classes.description: Interface for a client addressable rendezvous grain with methods to retrieve and assign a producer

methods.name: GetProducer
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the producer associated with this grain

methods.name: SetProducer
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the producer for this grain
